spec.name: Alpine Lake at Golden Hour
spec.axes: X east/right, Y north/depth, Z up
interpretations: Unseen rear shoreline completed as a woodland walking loop.
Cabins have closed doors; furnished interiors are outside the brief.
Distant alpine ridges are scenery, not climbable destinations.

regions.role: stream bridge, alpine meadow and path arrival
three separate woodland homes and connecting trail

composition_revisions: Recomposed inferred outer woodland from 330 trees to 110 with lower hill masses, keeping the lake valley intimate. This changes inferred composition; it is not an equivalent-scene performance comparison.

Halved the inferred horizontal basin extent and terrain elevations, retaining human-scale architecture, vegetation and rock geometry, to match the intimate reference proportions. Revalidated clearances after recomposition.

Replaced the uniformly closed forest wall with five reference-led groves, larger cabin clearings and two framing firs. Tree prototypes retain all original geometry and material detail; this is a composition revision, not a same-scene rendering speed comparison.

playable_domain.boundary: woodland and rocky valley slopes around the shore

composed_surroundings.purpose: Nonwalkable valley continuation and continuous measured alpine massif; playable area remains the intimate lakeside domain.

realism_revision.goal: Faithful photographic reconstruction, superseding the rejected stylized draft
realism_revision.mountains: continuous native-resolution Matterhorn-region DEM, authored placement and vertical scaling
realism_revision.trees: six new irregular branched spruce prototypes plus full-resolution botanical fir age variants
realism_revision.rocks: thirteen full scanned moss-rock variants replacing all smooth procedural boulders
realism_revision.ground: photographic grass, forest litter and rocky trail layers; shared source/runtime semantic weights
realism_revision.cabins: narrower facade proportions, steeper roofs and actual loft apertures
realism_revision.lighting: low warm western sun, blue/neutral sky fill; matched sky pending final calibration
realism_revision.meadow: Photographic grasses, low green shoots, fern and native flowering variants, plus original fully modeled daisy and buttercup clumps with curved thick petals, pollen discs and attached stems.
